name: Fireball
text: Cannot crit. Builds flammability and may ignite.

name: Kinetic Bolt
text: Ignores 30% armour. May bleed and impale.

name: Lightning
text: Rolls 10-100% damage. 50% base Shock gives a chance to strike again.

name: Ice Nova
text: Builds chill, which raises crit chance. 100 chill freezes.

name: Void Bloom
text: 40% poison and 60% corrosion chance. Poison deals 20% of the hit per tick for 3 ticks.

name: Meteor
text: Hits for 50% of base. Each chain drops 2 meteors for 17% of base that may ignite. Scorched adds one more.

name: Venom Volley
text: Hits for 50% of base. Each chain throws 6 fangs for 5.5% of base. 70% poison chance. Rotting adds 2 fangs.

name: Solar Spear
text: The strongest fire hit. Cannot crit. +20% more damage per active mark and chain, up to +100%.

name: Rupture
text: Hits for 50% of base and breaks 20% armour. After a cast that crits or bleeds, a chain tears 11 cuts of 3.1% of base.

name: Blade Vortex
text: 4 spinning blades. Breaks 10% armour per cast. Consumes Hunted to release every stored impale.

name: Frost Comet
text: Hits for 50% of base. Each chain adds 3 shards for 11% of base and 15 chill. Consumes freeze for Shatter.

name: Oblivion Ray
text: A 4-hit chaos beam. Corrosion makes it hit harder. +20% more damage per active mark and chain.

name: Chain Lightning
text: Hits for 50% of base. Each chain sends 4 arcs for 8.5% of base that may Shock. Conductive adds 2 arcs.

name: Tempest
text: A 4-hit storm. Consumes Conductive for +100% Shock and full-damage repeats. Can Paralyze (Paralyze perk).

name: Glacial Prison
text: Consumes Frostbitten to freeze at once (+100% crit damage). Consumes freeze for Lotus and Shatter.

name: Cinder Swarm
text: 5 embers. +45% ignite chance, +70% ignite effect. Leaves Scorched on the Guardian for 3 casts.

name: Furnace Brand
text: A fire seal. +150% flammability effect. Consumes Scorched for +100% more damage and double flammability.

name: Frost Shards
text: 3 ice shards. Double chill buildup. Leaves Frostbitten on the Guardian for 3 casts.

name: Absolute Zero
text: Triple chill, +50% crit damage. Consumes freeze for Lotus and Shatter. Grows with marks.

name: Serrated Volley
text: 4 serrated blades. +50% bleed chance and bleed effect. Leaves Hunted on the Guardian for 3 casts.

name: Iron Rain
text: 6 arrows. Ignores 20% armour. +60% impale chance and impale effect. Grows with marks.

name: Plague Orb
text: 90% poison chance. Poison deals double damage. Leaves Rotting on the Guardian for 3 casts.

name: Entropy Rift
text: Always corrodes. 50% poison and 50% bleed chance. Consumes Rotting to detonate all damage over time.

name: Static Lance
text: +5% base Shock. Leaves Conductive on the Guardian for 3 casts. Can Paralyze (Paralyze perk).

name: Thunder Crown
text: Each hit sets off a chaining blast, up to 12. +50% Lucky chance. Can Paralyze (Paralyze perk).

name: Kindled Will
text: Your next 3 casts deal 80% more damage with hits.

name: Smoulder Sigil
text: Damage over time (ignite, poison, bleed) applied by your next 3 casts deals 50% increased damage.

name: Glacial Focus
text: Your next 3 casts have +20% critical chance and +30% critical damage.

name: Rime Lens
text: Grants 1 Lotus that any skill can spend. Every hit of your next skill is critical, even fire.

name: Echo Spark
text: Your next 3 casts each have 15% chance to repeat.

name: Static Field
text: Your next 3 casts: +15% chance to apply ailments and +40% increased ailment effect.

name: Withering Hex
text: Hexes the Guardian for 3 casts: it takes 20% increased damage from every hit and tick.

name: Venom Coat
text: For your next 3 casts, every hit has 35% chance to poison, whatever its element.

name: Battle Trance
text: Your next 3 casts gain +70% base damage. Base damage counts before every other bonus, for hits and damage over time.

name: Sunder Mark
text: Marks the Guardian: 25% armour break, and for 3 casts all its elemental resistances drop by 15%.

name: Mana Shield
text: The Guardian's next strike deals 50% less.

name: Mend
text: Restores 25% of your most Ward.

name: Dispel
text: Turns off one Guardian defense (Guard, Stoneskin, Crit Ward, Shed or Regrowth) until its next strike.

name: Ember Lash
text: 3 lashes that build flammability. Scorched on the Guardian lasts 1 cast longer.

name: Rime Needle
text: 2 needles. +15% critical chance. Builds chill, which raises crit chance.

name: Steel Flurry
text: 5 quick cuts. Ignores 10% armour. Each hit releases a stored impale.

name: Spark Whip
text: Rolls 40-100% damage, steadier than Lightning. Shocked lasts 1 cast longer.

name: Hex Needle
text: 60% corrosion chance. Each corrosion also adds a poison stack.

name: Afterburn
text: A light hit, then replays your costliest resting fire skill at 60%, with more flammability.

name: Mirror Frost
text: A light hit, then replays your costliest resting ice skill at 60%, with more chill.

name: Rolling Thunder
text: A light hit, then replays your costliest resting lightning skill at 70%, always Lucky.

name: Lingering Blight
text: A light hit, then replays your costliest resting chaos skill at 60%, with stronger poison.

name: Phantom Edge
text: 2 light cuts, then replays your costliest resting physical skill at 80%. Guard cannot block it.

name: Phoenix Descent
text: 3 phoenix dives. 30% more damage while your Ward is below half. Grows with marks.

name: Glacier Fall
text: Triple chill. A Freeze it leaves holds through the Guardian strike. Grows with marks.

name: Skybreaker
text: One sure Shock repeat for each active mark and chain, up to 5. Grows with marks.

name: Black Sun
text: Every poison ticks at once. 50% poison chance. Poison stacks 3 higher for the fight.

name: Thousand Blades
text: 10 blades. Ignores 15% armour, +30% impale chance. Impale stacks 5 higher for the fight.

name: Ember Echo
text: Echoes the last fire skill before it: +20% per Focus, and at full Focus it repeats. Spends all Focus.

name: Gale Step
text: 1 cut, plus 1 per 5 Scar, each +30% crit chance; up to twice the damage at 20 Scar. Spends all Scar.

name: Brimstone Rupture
text: Fire, then poison: up to twice the damage at full Brimstone. Spends it and Exposes the Guardian (+20%).

name: Volatile Flask
text: +10 poison stacks, then a quarter of the stacks detonate without being removed (1.4 to 2 times).

name: Augury
text: +1 Omen and a strike with 25% more damage per different buff active. Your buffs keep their casts.
